layer_3_action.subject: Hazy, dramatic forest within a volcanic highland basin
features: Dark, jagged volcanic rocks covered in vibrant orange lichen
Dense canopy of Ginkgoes and Cycads with distinct fan-shaped leaves
Thin plumes of volcanic steam rising from dark, mossy crevices
A deep, mirror-still caldera lake reflecting a hazy sun
Layered ash deposits visible in the eroded hillsides
layer_3_action.action: A lush but alien forest under a hazy, amber sky. Volcanic activity creates a warm, steaming environment. The ground is a mix of dark ash and thick, primitive bryophyte mats. No grass.

visuals.ground: Grey volcanic tuff and charcoal-colored ash soil. Extremely thick carpets of liverworts and mosses. No grass.
visuals.water: Dark, mineral-rich lake water with occasional bubbles from geothermal vents.
visuals.sky: Amber-tinted haze caused by atmospheric ash; dramatic crepuscular rays.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Fine volcanic ash, porous basalt, and thick damp moss.

negative_prompt: grass, ocean, seagulls, oak trees, flowers, snow, ice, blue sky
